title: Studio zh-CN: one word left per state after #29705 — 已关闭 vs 已停用, 自定义 vs 定制, and Access's perm.badge.custom
body:
domain:ui#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jQjvWkZ7is6GXbC6DB

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a (measured, read in strings at `7b55ea95`), from #29705's premise. The #29705 claim amendment keeps its diff to All metadata and the badges. Filed by `domain:ui#5`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** #29705 sets one word per item state in Studio. Three zh spellings outside its diff still give the same state or act two names, so a builder still meets two words for one thing.

## What happens (zh strings at `7b55ea95`; see `/mnt/project-files/issue-29705/premise.md`)

1. The ledger switch says 本部署中已关闭, while the pillars' word for that state is 已停用 or switched off. #29705 settles which one.
2. The Customize verb reads 自定义 in some places and 定制 in others. #29705's mark word is 可定制, so the verb should be 定制.
3. Access's `perm.badge.custom` reads 自定义 for a customized permission set.

## Wanted

Each takes #29705's vocabulary as landed. Strings only, no new state. Most likely this is zh only. Check en for the same split while you are there.

## Tests

A string census or component pins for the three sites, in the same shape #29705 lands.

## Added by the seat from #29784 (#29705's PR)

4. en `engine.studio.auto.off` still reads "Off". #29784 kept it, because `ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` reds an en-only change without its zh row, and the waiver ledger's `ISSUE_PATTERN = /^objectui#\d+$/` (line 185) refuses an `objectstack#` number since the repo merge. Move en to "Switched off", and either widen `ISSUE_PATTERN` to accept `objectstack#N` (with its test in `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts`) or ship the zh row in the same diff so no waiver is needed.

Serialize after #29705's PR. If #29693 or #29691 have not landed yet, keep out of `StudioItemHeader.tsx`.

Dedupe: `is:issue 已停用 已关闭`, `is:issue perm.badge.custom` (none open).

Links back: #29705, ADR-0146 D1, #28130.
